Line 3. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-002, status under review, budget 7089 euros, deadline 2026-11-07. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.

Line 6. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-005, status suspended, budget 1666 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-006, status under review, budget 9417 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Paolo, responsible for the structures department, reports case P04-007, status approved, budget 3971 euros, deadline 2026-11-12. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Rita, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-008, status approved, budget 7430 euros, deadline 2026-11-13. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-009, status suspended, budget 8002 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
